name: Session prep
description: Prepare the next reading-circle meeting: pick passages, then draft discussion questions.

steps.name: Pick passages
steps.prompt: Read circle.json for the current book and chapter, and the most recent notes/ file if one exists. Choose two or three passages from the current stretch of the book that reward discussion, and write them into prep/passages.md with a line on why each earns its place.

steps.name: Draft questions
steps.prompt: From prep/passages.md, draft five discussion questions in prep/questions.md. Make each question specific to this book and this stretch of it; a question that fits any novel is not done. End with one lighter opener the host can start with.
